title: swarm
description: Manage the swarm of agents working on the shared message board.

action.description: Action to perform: status, models, add, bind, model, kill, title, or channel.

name.description: Roster name of the worker (short, lowercase, no spaces).

brief.description: The worker's assignment for add: what it owns and what done looks like. Posted publicly on the board as @<name> <brief>.

mode.description: Force coordinator-mediated subagent delegation for add.

job_id.description: Harness background job handle for bind action.

state.description: Latest harness job state for bind action.

model.description: Model to run this member on. Unset means its role tier: workers and verifiers get the full tier, the monitor and narrator the mini tier. Also accepts a model name, a name(level) variant, a @mg:<group> reference, or the aliases full, mini, nano, and session.

workspace.description: Workspace isolation mode: inherit shares parent directory, share gives an isolated worktree, branch creates an isolated clone.

fork.description: Optional roster name of an existing member (or 'coordinator') whose conversation history this worker forks from.

n.description: Number of homogeneous copies to spawn (<name>-1 through <name>-<n>).

tasks.description: Per-worker slice targets for sharded groups (<name>-1 through <name>-<len>).

title.description: A short descriptive title for the swarm.

channels.description: Initial channels to subscribe the new worker to.

all.description: For models: list all available models.

caller.description: Optional caller roster name override when sharing a single MCP server.
